config.name: Nodes ready
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  countIf(ready = 1) AS "Nodes ready"
FROM (
  SELECT ResourceAttributes['k8s.node.name'] AS node, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS ready
  FROM default.otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE MetricName = 'k8s.node.condition_ready' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
  GROUP BY node
)

config.name: Nodes NOT ready
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  countIf(ready != 1) AS "Nodes not ready"
FROM (
  SELECT ResourceAttributes['k8s.node.name'] AS node, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS ready
  FROM default.otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE MetricName = 'k8s.node.condition_ready' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
  GROUP BY node
)

config.name: CPU
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT round(avg("CPU %"), 1) AS "CPU %" FROM (
SELECT
  ts,
  greatest(0, least(100, 100 * (1 - idle_d / total_d))) AS "CPU %"
FROM (
  SELECT
    ts,
    idle - lagInFrame(idle) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS idle_d,
    total - lagInFrame(total) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS total_d,
    row_number() OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT ts, sumIf(v, state = 'idle') AS idle, sum(v) AS total
    FROM (
      SELECT
        $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts,
        Attributes['cpu'] AS cpu,
        Attributes['state'] AS state,
        argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v
      FROM default.otel_metrics_sum
      WHERE MetricName = 'system.cpu.time' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
      GROUP BY ts, cpu, state
    )
    GROUP BY ts
  )
)
WHERE rn > 1 AND total_d > 0
ORDER BY ts
)

config.name: Memory
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT round(avg("Memory %"), 1) AS "Memory %" FROM (
SELECT
  ts,
  100 * used / nullIf(total, 0) AS "Memory %"
FROM (
  SELECT ts, sumIf(v, state = 'used') AS used, sum(v) AS total
  FROM (
    SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts, Attributes['state'] AS state, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v
    FROM default.otel_metrics_sum
    WHERE MetricName = 'system.memory.usage' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
    GROUP BY ts, state
  )
  GROUP BY ts
)
ORDER BY ts
)

config.name: Fullest filesystem
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT round(max(pct), 1) AS "Fullest disk %" FROM (
  SELECT
    mountpoint,
    100 * argMax(used, ts) / nullIf(argMax(used + free + reserved, ts), 0) AS pct
  FROM (
  SELECT
    $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts,
    Attributes['mountpoint'] AS mountpoint,
    any(Attributes['type']) AS fstype,
    argMaxIf(Value, TimeUnix, Attributes['state'] = 'used') AS used,
    argMaxIf(Value, TimeUnix, Attributes['state'] = 'free') AS free,
    argMaxIf(Value, TimeUnix, Attributes['state'] = 'reserved') AS reserved
  FROM default.otel_metrics_sum
  WHERE MetricName = 'system.filesystem.usage' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
  GROUP BY ts, mountpoint
  )
  GROUP BY mountpoint
)

config.name: Pods
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT countDistinct(ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name']) AS "Pods"
FROM default.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE MetricName = 'k8s.pod.cpu.usage' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)

config.name: CPU utilisation
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  ts,
  greatest(0, least(100, 100 * (1 - idle_d / total_d))) AS "CPU %"
FROM (
  SELECT
    ts,
    idle - lagInFrame(idle) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS idle_d,
    total - lagInFrame(total) OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS total_d,
    row_number() OVER (ORDER BY ts) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT ts, sumIf(v, state = 'idle') AS idle, sum(v) AS total
    FROM (
      SELECT
        $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts,
        Attributes['cpu'] AS cpu,

        argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v
      FROM default.otel_metrics_sum

config.name: CPU by state
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  ts,
  state AS "State",
  greatest(0, 100 * d / nullIf(cores * $__interval_s, 0)) AS "CPU %"
FROM (
  SELECT
    ts,
    state,
    cores,
    v - lagInFrame(v) OVER (PARTITION BY state ORDER BY ts) AS d,
    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY state ORDER BY ts) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT ts, state, sum(v) AS v, count() AS cores
    FROM (
      SELECT
        $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts,
        Attributes['state'] AS state,
        Attributes['cpu'] AS cpu,
        argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v
      FROM default.otel_metrics_sum
      WHERE MetricName = 'system.cpu.time' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
        AND Attributes['state'] != 'idle'
      GROUP BY ts, state, cpu
    )
    GROUP BY ts, state
  )
)
WHERE rn > 1 AND d >= 0
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Load average
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts,
  avgIf(Value, MetricName = 'system.cpu.load_average.1m') AS "1m",
  avgIf(Value, MetricName = 'system.cpu.load_average.5m') AS "5m",
  avgIf(Value, MetricName = 'system.cpu.load_average.15m') AS "15m"
FROM default.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE MetricName IN ('system.cpu.load_average.1m', 'system.cpu.load_average.5m',
                     'system.cpu.load_average.15m')
  AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Filesystem used
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  ts,
  mountpoint AS "Mount point",
  100 * used / nullIf(used + free + reserved, 0) AS "Used %"
FROM (
  SELECT
    $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts,
    Attributes['mountpoint'] AS mountpoint,
    any(Attributes['type']) AS fstype,
    argMaxIf(Value, TimeUnix, Attributes['state'] = 'used') AS used,
    argMaxIf(Value, TimeUnix, Attributes['state'] = 'free') AS free,
    argMaxIf(Value, TimeUnix, Attributes['state'] = 'reserved') AS reserved
  FROM default.otel_metrics_sum
  WHERE MetricName = 'system.filesystem.usage' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
  GROUP BY ts, mountpoint
)
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Filesystems
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  mountpoint AS "Mount point",
  argMax(fstype, ts) AS "Type",
  formatReadableSize(argMax(used, ts)) AS "Used",
  formatReadableSize(argMax(used + free + reserved, ts)) AS "Size",
  round(100 * argMax(used, ts) / nullIf(argMax(used + free + reserved, ts), 0), 1) AS "Used %"
FROM (
  SELECT
    $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts,
    Attributes['mountpoint'] AS mountpoint,
    any(Attributes['type']) AS fstype,
    argMaxIf(Value, TimeUnix, Attributes['state'] = 'used') AS used,
    argMaxIf(Value, TimeUnix, Attributes['state'] = 'free') AS free,
    argMaxIf(Value, TimeUnix, Attributes['state'] = 'reserved') AS reserved
  FROM default.otel_metrics_sum
  WHERE MetricName = 'system.filesystem.usage' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
  GROUP BY ts, mountpoint
)
GROUP BY mountpoint
ORDER BY "Used %" DESC

config.name: Disk throughput
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  ts,
  series AS "Device",
  d / $__interval_s AS "Bytes/s"
FROM (
  SELECT
    ts,
    series,
    v - lagInFrame(v) OVER (PARTITION BY series ORDER BY ts) AS d,
    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY series ORDER BY ts) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts,
      concat(Attributes['device'], ' ', Attributes['direction']) AS series,
      argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v
    FROM default.otel_metrics_sum
    WHERE MetricName = 'system.disk.io' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
        AND Attributes['device'] NOT LIKE 'loop%'
    GROUP BY ts, series
  )
)
WHERE rn > 1 AND d >= 0
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Disk IOPS
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  ts,
  series AS "Device",
  d / $__interval_s AS "Ops/s"
FROM (
  SELECT
    ts,

    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY series ORDER BY ts) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts,
      concat(Attributes['device'], ' ', Attributes['direction']) AS series,
      argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v
    FROM default.otel_metrics_sum
    WHERE MetricName = 'system.disk.operations' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
        AND Attributes['device'] NOT LIKE 'loop%'
    GROUP BY ts, series
  )
)
WHERE rn > 1 AND d >= 0
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Disk busy
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  ts,
  series AS "Device",
  d / ($__interval_s / 100) AS "Busy %"
FROM (
  SELECT
    ts,
    series,
    v - lagInFrame(v) OVER (PARTITION BY series ORDER BY ts) AS d,
    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY series ORDER BY ts) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts,
      Attributes['device'] AS series,
      argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v
    FROM default.otel_metrics_sum
    WHERE MetricName = 'system.disk.io_time' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
        AND Attributes['device'] NOT LIKE 'loop%'
    GROUP BY ts, series
  )
)
WHERE rn > 1 AND d >= 0
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Network throughput
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  ts,
  series AS "Interface",
  d / $__interval_s AS "Bytes/s"
FROM (
  SELECT
    ts,
    series,
    v - lagInFrame(v) OVER (PARTITION BY series ORDER BY ts) AS d,
    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY series ORDER BY ts) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts,
      concat(Attributes['device'], ' ', Attributes['direction']) AS series,
      argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v
    FROM default.otel_metrics_sum
    WHERE MetricName = 'system.network.io' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
        AND Attributes['device'] NOT IN ('lo', 'sit0', 'ip6tnl0', 'tunl0', 'erspan0', 'gre0', 'gretap0')
    GROUP BY ts, series
  )
)
WHERE rn > 1 AND d >= 0
ORDER BY ts

config.sqlTemplate:

config.name: Network errors & drops
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  ts,
  series AS "Problem",
  d / $__interval_s AS "Per second"
FROM (
  SELECT
    ts,
    series,
    v - lagInFrame(v) OVER (PARTITION BY series ORDER BY ts) AS d,
    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY series ORDER BY ts) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts,
      concat(if(MetricName = 'system.network.errors', 'errors', 'dropped'),
             ' ', Attributes['direction']) AS series,
      sum(Value) AS v
    FROM default.otel_metrics_sum
    WHERE MetricName IN ('system.network.errors', 'system.network.dropped')
      AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
    GROUP BY ts, series
  )
)
WHERE rn > 1 AND d >= 0
ORDER BY ts

config.name: TCP connections
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  ts,
  state AS "State",
  v AS "Connections"
FROM (
  SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts, Attributes['state'] AS state, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v
  FROM default.otel_metrics_sum
  WHERE MetricName = 'system.network.connections' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
    AND Attributes['protocol'] = 'tcp'
  GROUP BY ts, state
)
WHERE v >= 1
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Pods per namespace
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts,
  ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] AS "Namespace",
  countDistinct(ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name']) AS "Pods"
FROM default.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE MetricName = 'k8s.pod.cpu.usage' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY ts, "Namespace"
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Top pods by CPU
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] AS "Namespace",
  ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS "Pod",
  round(avg(Value), 3) AS "Cores (avg)",
  round(max(Value), 3) AS "Cores (peak)"
FROM default.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE MetricName = 'k8s.pod.cpu.usage' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY "Namespace", "Pod"
ORDER BY "Cores (avg)" DESC
LIMIT 20

config.name: Top pods by memory
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] AS "Namespace",
  ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS "Pod",
  formatReadableSize(avg(Value)) AS "Working set (avg)",
  formatReadableSize(max(Value)) AS "Working set (peak)",
  round(avg(Value)) AS "Bytes"
FROM default.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE MetricName = 'k8s.pod.memory.working_set' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY "Namespace", "Pod"
ORDER BY "Bytes" DESC
LIMIT 20

config.name: Container restarts
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] AS "Namespace",
  ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS "Pod",
  ResourceAttributes['k8s.container.name'] AS "Container",
  toUInt64(max(Value)) AS "Restarts"
FROM default.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE MetricName = 'k8s.container.restarts' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY "Namespace", "Pod", "Container"
HAVING "Restarts" > 0
ORDER BY "Restarts" DESC
LIMIT 20
